acceptance_batch.formal_result: PASS_PENDING_EVIDENCE_REVIEW until the browser observation is reviewed and recorded

preconditions: P5.3 implementation installed on a disposable Odoo 18 database
Codex model catalog exposes at least one selectable model when the current selection is default
gates.user: internal disposable test user with normal Assistant preferences
gates.data: two long read-only turns in separate conversations; no Odoo business mutation
gates.injection: change model and autonomy selectors through the real Assistant UI while Turn A is unresolved
gates.action: capture Turn A reasoning_model, policy_payload and execution_settings_payload; change selectors; prove A remains unchanged; enqueue Turn B; prove B captures the new model/profile/policy in snapshot format v1
gates.backend_expected: Turn A remains bound to its original persisted model/policy/versioned snapshot; Turn B captures the changed preferences; execution_settings_payload.policy equals the persisted policy_payload for each turn
gates.browser_expected: model/autonomy controls and new-chat remain usable while Turn A is unresolved
gates.approval_resume: same-turn approval/requeue retention is covered by the preceding deterministic P5.3 regression; the real browser fixture is deliberately read-only so approval is not applicable
gates.redaction: only bounded turn ids, model/profile names and snapshot format are emitted; policy payloads, prompts, answers, provider internals and credentials are not printed
gates.cleanup: restore original user model/autonomy preferences, cancel unresolved read-only turns and drop the disposable database/filestore after validation
